title: 5-Year Treasury Note auction (December new issue) — announced on Christmas Eve, sharing Monday 12-28 with the 2-Year
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), fetched direct by plain curl 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes) and its text layer decompressed stream-by-stream by the treasury-7y-note-2026-12-29 initial research. Row reads verbatim `5-Year NOTE Thursday, December 24, 2026 Monday, December 28, 2026 Thursday, December 31, 2026` with NO trailing `R`, so a new issue — and the flag column IS populated in the same December block (`2-Year FRN R`, `20-Year BOND R`, `5-Year TIPS R T`), so the blank is a signal rather than a missing field. Filed estimate on the two limits this lane records: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep — the confirming primary is the 2026-12-24 announcement. Discovered in the never-assessed initial research of treasury-7y-note-2026-12-29, 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED 2026-09-09 by the treasury-7y-note-2026-12-29 never-assessed initial research, one day inside its five-day corridor and previously untracked. WHY IT EARNS A ROW: this is the belly leg of a December month-end coupon block compressed onto TWO sessions instead of three — 2-Year and 5-Year both on Monday 2026-12-28, 7-Year on Tuesday 12-29, all three settling Thursday 12-31 on the last business day of the year. The 5-Year is the immediate curve neighbour of the 7-Year the proposing research owns, and the sibling treasury-7y-note-2026-11-25 research found the 5Y-10Y spread was NOT a clean placebo for the 7Y auction-day effect (+0.273bp, t = 0.96 over 2023+, but -0.491bp, t = -2.98 over 2014-2021), so a 5-Year auctioning the day BEFORE the 7-Year is a confound the 12-29 ledger has to read rather than assume away. Calendar precedent: 2020-12-28 is the only other December in the record where the 2Y and 5Y shared an auction date, and 2026's late-December weekdays are identical to 2020's. Announced Thursday 12-24 for a Monday 12-28 auction — one business day of when-issued trading against the 3-5 that is normal. Read-it-do-not-trade-it: `symbols: []` and the date is `estimate`.
